title: 第17章 赐予弑神枪挑选神算术第18章 测算气运忽悠入峰
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“可恶，算计十几年，这次倒是失算了……”
“不行这种出丑的事情，不能只有我一个人。”
“我的赶紧找个师弟师妹，这样我也就能取笑他们了。”
“嗯，就这样。”
心中这么想着，姬无道也正式开始翻找起适合他的功法武技。
毕竟已经在徐洋面前丢脸了，想再多也没用，还不如赶紧弄本帝级功法弥补一下自己。
见姬无道开始了正事，徐洋也不再观望他，毕竟接下来的过程，也没有什么好看的。
“师尊，那个，弟子还有件事情想要问问您。”
“不知道您方不方便？”
转过身，徐洋又打起了李如风的主意。
“你先问，到时候我再说方不方便。”
李如风淡淡道。
“额……”听到李如风的话，徐洋一愣，都差点忘记接下来想要问什么了。
“是这样的，我是想问问，师尊您这里有适合我的武器吗？”
“当然，弟子也就这么一问，您没有的话，我在去想想其他办法。”
下一刻，徐洋笑着开口道。
自从见到李如风能轻易拿出那么多帝级功法武技，徐洋就觉得李如风这里肯定有很多好东西。
本着肥水不流外人田，身为弟子，找自己师尊好点好东西，这很合理吧？
“武器？”
“你小子，把我这里当成百宝阁了？”

“想要什么就直接跟我要，是吧？”
李如风睁开双眼瞥了一眼满是笑容的徐洋，随即弱弱道。
“咳咳，师尊哪里话，我这样，其实也是为了您考虑啊。”
“毕竟只要弟子的实力强大了，这样也就能替师尊你解决一些麻烦的事情。”
“如此一来，师尊您不就是能更好的躺…不对，更好的休息了吗？”
“嘿嘿！”
徐洋狡辩……辩解道。
“这话说出来，你自己信吗？”
“不过有句话不错，你实力越强，为师确实能更好的躺……休息。”
“正好为师这里确实有一件很适合你的武器，就赏给你了。”
李如风并没有跟徐洋太过计较，毕竟怎么也是他的便宜弟子，该大方还是要大方点。
说完这番话，李如风便将不久前签到的弑神枪拿了出来。
而在看到弑神枪的那一刻，徐洋就彻底被其深深给吸引住了。
数息后，徐洋开口道：“师尊，这是？”
“弑神枪，一般般，你别嫌弃。”
说完，李如风便将弑神枪扔给徐洋。
徐洋见状立马双手接了过来。
在拿到弑神枪的一刹那，一道无比恐怖的气息就从弑神枪身上散发出来。
“师尊，我……”
在弑神枪那恐怖的气息下，徐洋感觉下一刻他就要神魂俱灭一般。
content_en:
"Damn it, I have been planning for more than ten years, but this time I miscalculated..."
"No, I can't be the only one doing this kind of embarrassing thing."
"I need to find a junior brother and sister quickly so that I can make fun of them."
"Well, that's it."
With this thought in his mind, Ji Wudao officially began to search for martial arts and martial arts that suited him.
After all, he has already been embarrassed in front of Xu Yang, and there is no point in thinking about it any more. He might as well quickly make up for himself by using his emperor-level skills.
Seeing Ji Wudao getting down to business, Xu Yang stopped watching him. After all, there was nothing interesting to watch in the next process.
"Master, um, this disciple has something else I want to ask you."
"I wonder if it's inconvenient for you?"
Turning around, Xu Yang came up with Li Rufeng's idea again.
"You ask first, and I'll tell you later if it's inconvenient."
Li Rufeng said calmly.
"Uh..." Xu Yang was stunned when he heard Li Rufeng's words and almost forgot what he wanted to ask next.
"That's right, I just want to ask, Master, do you have any weapons suitable for me?"
"Of course, this is what I ask, disciple. If you don't have it, I will think of other ways."
The next moment, Xu Yang said with a smile.
Ever since he saw that Li Rufeng could easily produce so many emperor-level martial arts skills, Xu Yang felt that Li Rufeng must have a lot of good things here.
In line with the principle that wealth should not go to outsiders, as a disciple, it is reasonable to ask your master for some good things, right?
"Weapon?"
"You kid, do you think this place is Baibao Pavilion?"
"If you want anything, just ask me, right?"
Li Rufeng opened his eyes and glanced at Xu Yang, who was full of smiles, and then said weakly.
"Ahem, Master, what are you talking about? I am doing this because of your consideration."
"After all, as long as the disciple's strength becomes stronger, I can solve some troublesome things for you, Master."
"In this way, Master, wouldn't you be able to lie down better... no, have a better rest?"
"Hey!"
Xu Yang quibbled...justified.
"If you say this, do you believe it yourself?"
"But there is a saying that is true. The stronger you are, the better you can lie down and rest as a teacher."
"It just so happens that there is a weapon here that suits you very well, so I will reward it to you."
Li Rufeng didn't care too much about Xu Yang. After all, he was still his cheap disciple, so he had to be more generous.
After saying these words, Li Rufeng took out the God-killing Spear that he had signed not long ago.
The moment he saw the God-killing Spear, Xu Yang was completely attracted by it.
After a few breaths, Xu Yang said: "Master, what is this?"
"The God-killing Spear is just so-so, don't dislike it."
After saying that, Li Rufeng threw the God-killing Spear to Xu Yang.
Seeing this, Xu Yang immediately took it with both hands.
The moment he got the God-killing Spear, an extremely terrifying aura emanated from the God-killing Spear.
"Master, I..."
Under the terrifying aura of the God-killing Spear, Xu Yang felt as if his soul would be destroyed in the next moment.
